title: Project Management
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: apply a significant range of professional and business skills, practices and techniques in project management.
initiate, manage and drive change through the application of sound financial and business competence.
undertake individual and team research and/or consultancy based projects.
describe the nature and functions of project management as well as understand the project life cycle and processes.

build a cohesive and productive project team and learn techniques to deal with the practical and emotional issues involved in team building including coordinating efforts across multiple units of the organization.
apply and use project management software and techniques to plan, monitor, control, and evaluate a project.

notes: The requirements table titles PRJMGT 320 'Project Time and Cost Management' and PRJMGT 330 'Project Planning', while the course descriptions and closed list title PRJMGT 320 'Leading Project Teams though Stakeholder & Communications Management' and the closed list titles PRJMGT 330 'Project Management'; codes match, so recorded by code.
The block's stated total uses the printed 'Total Units: 18', which is the certificate total.

Careers taken from the Career Information section; the program description also lists industries (Health Care, Pharmacy, Human Resources, Finance, Manufacturing, Construction, Information Technology) as professional services where project work applies; these were not recorded as careers.
